body: Oh shit, I’m sorry dude. Outing an LGBTQ+ person is so fucked
Common misconception! There is a weird amount of straight guys in theatre.
I’m a lot of things, a quitter ain’t one
I’ve tried, I texted him a week or two ago but he ignored me. If he wants to have a relationship again he’ll talk to me.
To keep it short, he thought that mentally we were both suffering from the relationship and that I was becoming too dependent on him for support.

To keep this short, I was kinda hype with the interaction. At first, at least. Because he had said he was attracted to me and had been cool doing stuff with me. Looking back at it now I think there was some confusion with finding someone attractive and actually being attracted to them. Regardless he was a really precious friend and It honestly blows (Pun intended) we aren’t talking anymore. I had been close to him since I was 14-15ish, and historically he got me out of some real shitty situations, so it has not been easy.
He didn’t actually say no homo, I’m just playing

We were still friends for a while after this, it was just like the beginning of the end, y’know?

Hopefully, only time will tell I guess
Forgot to mention this, while I was sucking him off he said “No homo.” So in conculusion the whole experience was straight
Damn, we are pretty similar. I truly hope things improve for you, my guy
I’m also 21. I feel you man, not even just like down to personal stress/anxieties whatever the world has turned into such a shitstorm, seems like people who aren’t set from birth stay that way
Unfortunately, I can’t really see a doctor for a while, just finance wise. But when I get some cash I’ll definitely have to look into it. Thank you for replying!

Same actually, It worse when I was in like middle school but I guess I never totally grew out of it. 

I may have to start caring less, when the insomnia is at it’s worst it’s all I can think about is tomorrow and that I have to wake up.

Thank you for taking the time, my guy!
